newsitem.title: USA: Applied Microsystems cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: Applied Microsystems cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist cut its rating on shares of Applied Microsystems Corp from buy to hold after the company on Friday said it will likely report a loss for the first quarter.
-- In a statement, the investment research firm also said it cut its March quarter earnings estimate to a loss of $0.07 a share from a previously forecast profit of $0.15 a share.
-- Applied Microsystems attributed the loss to longer than expected sales cycles and unfavorable currency exchange rates.
